$comment: Bundled offline fallback for the AIAS postcode-existence check (Feature 174 / M1, SC-007). When postcodes.io is unreachable (no venue internet) the PostcodeExistsCheck resolves UK postcodes against this allow-list. Matching is case- and whitespace-insensitive. Add the postcodes your demo applicants will use. These are real, well-known UK postcodes.
